title: 投籃機
question: 有一台投籃機，投進的球皆設定為2分球或3分球。得分超過30分便通關，且會記錄投了幾次球，請完成此投籃機程式，根據每次投球的得分，顯示投了幾顆球。

test_case.note: 投進2分球6顆，3分球6顆後通關。共投了12顆球。
沒投進5顆，投進2分球2顆，3分球9顆後通關。共投了16顆球。

en.title: Basketball Game
en.question: A basketball game. Each ball you get in is 2 points or 3 points. Get more than 30 points to win. Input the points of each throw. Output how many balls you threw.

test_case.note: Six 2-point balls and six 3-point balls, then you win. 12 balls in total.
5 misses, two 2-point balls, nine 3-point balls, then you win. 16 balls in total.
